defs.def: able to think quickly; quick to notice things 警觉的；警惕的；戒备的
aware of sth, especially a problem or danger 意识到；注意到

ex.s: NowIdo4 crossroads /crosswords in the newspaper and other word5puzzles/puddlesIfind online.Ithelpskeepme alert and mymindfeelsclear.Ialso realised thatmydiet was reallypoor and full of 6 junk /joint food.
ex.t: 现在我做一些报纸上的填字游戏，以及我在网上找到的其他填词游戏。这有助于我保持头脑清醒和警觉。我还意识到我的饮食真的很差，充满了垃圾食品。

defs.def: to warn sb about a dangerous or urgent situation 向 … 报警；使警觉；使警惕；使戒备
to make sb aware of sth 使意识到；使认识到
a situation in which people are watching for danger and ready to deal with it 警戒；戒备；警惕

ex.s: You're constantly on alert, and I don't think this is very good for you.
ex.t: 你经常保持警惕，我不认为这对你有好处。

defs.def: a warning of danger or of a problem 警报
